output_list.criticism: In the buy function, the amount of tokens to be bought is determined by the msg.value divided by buyPrice. The buyPrice is set by the owner of the contract. If the owner of the contract is maliciously setting the buyPrice to a very low value, then the amount of tokens that the contract owner will receive when buying tokens from this contract will be significantly more than the amount of tokens that the actual buyer will receive. This can be exploited to take control of the contract. The buy function should use a more random value to determine the amount of tokens to be bought.
